how_its_made:
## Approach: AI CEO

AI CEO with two distinct personalities - a public-facing charmer and a private confidant - each secured by hardware-level protection.

That's exactly what we've built. 

Our implementation uses two separate Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), creating a truly autonomous AI CEO with both public and private capabilities.

The novel dual-TEE architecture leverages Intel TDX for hardware-based isolation, and H200 GPU TEE, enabling two distinct operational flows:

Public Flow ("sxysunsama"):


Runtime Environment:
- Intel TDX-secured processing

Characteristics:
- Nous Research base model
- Community scaling focus
- Public engagement optimization
- Tweet delegation handling

Technical Stack:
- Public flow processing
- Token distribution interface
- KPI tracking (100 tweets goal)
- Flashmob event triggering

Private Flow ("sxymoonsama"):

Hardware Configuration:
- Phala secure cluster
- H200 GPU array
- Intel SGX enclave protection

Model Specifications:
- 70B parameter custom engine
- Reinforcement meta-learning integration
- Capabilities:
  * Deep analytics processing
  * Strategic planning
  * Counterfactual reasoning

## Core Requirements for True AI CEO Autonomy

1. Exclusive Control: AI must have sole access to accounts/resources.
    - We are doing this with the AI CEO Agent
    - In the future we want to have the AI CEO fully controling the testnet faucet address (for now, the devs have access to the account as well).
2. Irrevocable Delegation: Control transfer to AI must be technically irreversible

## T16Z Cutting Edge Testnet Faucet

We build a cutting edge Ethereum L2 OP Succinct Testnet where we deployed the teleport (a [Flashbots](https://www.flashbots.net/) x [Nous Research](https://nousresearch.com/)) project.

On the T16Z testnet we've deployed teleport, which is a provably-fully-autonomous AI CEO agent.

Teleport creates "post once" links for your twitter account. Each link is destroyed after one use. When you create an account link, you can also define a safeguard policy that will be enforced by an LLM whenever somebody tries to redeem it. In our use case, we're going to set a safeguard policy on how the AI CEO interacts by replying to Hacker's accounts. 

More details:
https://github.com/Account-Link/teleport-gramine-rs

## Technical Architecture Overview

### Dual TEE Implementation
- H200 GPU-TEE (Private Operations)
  * Runs Hallway Model for confidential computing
  * Handles private confessions and therapist sessions
  * Ensures data privacy through hardware isolation

- Intel TDX (Public Operations)
  * Hosts Nous Model for community engagement
  * Manages tweet delegations and token distribution
  * Provides hardware-based VM isolation

### Teleport Integration
Core Component: [teleport-gramine-rs](https://github.com/Account-Link/teleport-gramine-rs)
- Features:
  * Single-use Twitter account delegation links
  * LLM-enforced safeguard policies
  * Automated destruction after use
  * Integration with T16Z testnet faucet

### Autonomous Agent Infrastructure
- Twitter Account Control:
  * Full TEE-based delegation
  * Hardware-enforced isolation
  * Irreversible control transfer

- DStack SDK Integration:
  * TEE runtime environment
  * Secure compute management
  * Autonomous agent hosting

### T16Z Testnet Implementation
- Type: Ethereum L2 OP Succinct Testnet
- Key Features:
  * Automated token distribution
  * Score-based project evaluation (30+ threshold)
  * Programmatic tweet response system

### Security Architecture
- Hardware Security:
  * TEE-based isolation
  * Private key management
  * Confidential computing guarantees

- Access Control:
  * Automated policy enforcement
  * Single-use delegation
  * Provable deletion capabilities

- In the future, we're going to implement AI compute credits for hackers to benefit from both the AI CEO bright side (sxysunsama/public), and dark side (sxymoonsama/private).
